packet.defect: SEC-1 expires a session token after 15 minutes without user input, but a full export runs up to 2 hours with no user input and the page authenticates every poll with that token, so the page loses access before the export finishes.
evidence_quotes: A session token expires after 15 minutes without user input
The page polls the job endpoint every 10 seconds and authenticates each poll with the user's session token
A full-project export can run for up to 2 hours
